easyPrerequisites:
Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
description:
Cast Mox Diamond either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Mox Diamond by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mox Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
